# promote-skill fixtures

Synthetic material for `tests/test_promote_skill.py`. Nothing here is a real
work skill; "Example Corp" and every host under `.internal` are invented.

- `source/diagram-as-code/` - a "work" skill with planted company details
  (absolute home path, internal URLs, a private registry, a confidentiality
  marker). Credential-like strings are generated by the tests at runtime and
  are never stored in the repository.
- `personal/description.md` - an authorized, generic description for
  personal mode (no source files).
- `candidate/skill-promotion/` - the portable candidate both modes should
  produce: `manifest.json` (status `draft`), `REVIEW.md` (status `pending`),
  and `skill/`.
